example_en: The laboratory received a brand new microscope this week.
example_zh: 实验室本周收到了一台崭新的显微镜。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示数量或价值相等，也可表示有能力应对任务。
example_en: One kilometer is equal to one thousand meters.
example_zh: 一公里等于一千米。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 对某事负责；是某事的原因
usage_note_zh: 可说明职责范围，也可指出导致某个结果的人或事物。
example_en: Each team is responsible for checking its own equipment.
example_zh: 每支队伍都负责检查自己的设备。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可接时间说明预定安排，也可与 to 连用说明原因或应付事项。
example_en: The train will be due at platform four in ten minutes.
example_zh: 这趟列车预计十分钟后到达四号站台。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示处于视野内，也可比喻目标即将实现。
example_en: After hours of walking, the village finally came in sight.
example_zh: 走了几个小时后，村庄终于出现在视野中。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 是 valuable 的最高级形式，通常与 the 或物主限定词连用。
example_en: Trust is our most valuable resource during a crisis.
example_zh: 危机期间，信任是我们最宝贵的资源。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 现代英语中更常写作 well-being 或 wellbeing，本条保留母表词形用于识别。
example_en: Safe housing has a direct effect on people's well being.
example_zh: 安全的住房会直接影响人们的身心福祉。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示一个人的整个身心，常与投入、奉献等含义连用。
example_en: She devoted body and soul to caring for the injured animals.
example_zh: 她全身心投入到照顾受伤动物的工作中。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示投入全部热情，也可指组织或活动最重要的推动者。
example_en: The volunteers put their heart and soul into rebuilding the playground.
example_zh: 志愿者们全心全意地重建操场。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于指出与另一个对象共有的特征或情况。
example_en: In common with many coastal towns, this area depends on tourism.
example_zh: 与许多沿海城镇一样，这个地区依赖旅游业。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 在空中；可感觉到；悬而未决
usage_note_zh: 可按字面表示在空气中，也可指气氛明显或事情尚未确定。
example_en: A sense of excitement was in the air before the final performance.
example_zh: 最后一场演出前，空气中洋溢着兴奋的气氛。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 在手头；在掌握中；正在处理
usage_note_zh: 可表示拥有可用资源、控制住局面或正在处理事情。
example_en: With enough supplies in hand, the team continued its journey.
example_zh: 手头有了足够物资，队伍继续前行。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 在适当位置；准备就绪；正在实施
usage_note_zh: 可表示位置正确，也可说明制度或安排已经建立。
example_en: All safety measures must be in place before the event begins.
example_zh: 活动开始前，所有安全措施都必须落实到位。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示按顺序行动，也可说明一个结果进一步引起另一个结果。
example_en: Each group will in turn present its findings to the class.
example_zh: 每个小组将依次向全班汇报研究结果。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示过去存在的状态或动作现在已经停止。
example_en: The old bridge is no longer safe for heavy vehicles.
example_zh: 这座旧桥已不再适合重型车辆通行。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于连接两个对等成分，表示选择或对比。
example_en: We should repair useful items rather than throw them away.
example_zh: 我们应该修理有用的物品，而不是把它们扔掉。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于引出前述原因导致的结果，后接 of 时可引出原因。
example_en: The road was flooded; as a result, the bus service stopped.
example_zh: 道路被淹，因此公共汽车停运了。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 引导方式或表语从句；与事实相反时常使用虚拟形式。
example_en: He spoke as if he had witnessed the event himself.
example_zh: 他说得仿佛亲眼目睹了这件事。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 引导让步状语从句，后接完整的主语和谓语。
example_en: Even though the route was steep, everyone reached the top safely.
example_zh: 尽管路线陡峭，所有人仍安全到达了山顶。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: of 是介词，后接名词、代词或动名词。
example_en: We took the train instead of driving through the storm.
example_zh: 我们乘火车出行，没有冒雨开车。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接名词、代词或动名词，不能直接连接完整句子。
example_en: The outdoor concert was canceled because of strong winds.
example_zh: 由于强风，露天音乐会被取消了。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接带来某种结果的人或事，常表示积极原因，也可用于反讽语境。
example_en: Thanks to careful planning, the move was completed in one day.
example_zh: 多亏周密计划，搬迁在一天内就完成了。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 to do 或 against 连用，表示为解决问题而采取具体措施。
example_en: Communities must take action to protect local water sources.
example_zh: 社区必须采取行动保护当地水源。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示行动使情况发生明显改善或变化，常与 to 连用。
example_en: Even a small donation can make a difference to the project.
example_zh: 即使一小笔捐款也能对这个项目产生影响。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示处理问题、与某人打交道，也可说明文章或课程的主题。
example_en: The training teaches staff how to deal with emergencies.
example_zh: 培训教员工如何应对紧急情况。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可按字面表示道路通往某地，也可说明某事造成某种结果。
example_en: A lack of sleep can lead to poor concentration.
example_zh: 睡眠不足会导致注意力不集中。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接结果，主语通常是引发该结果的原因。
example_en: Ignoring a minor fault may result in a costly repair later.
example_zh: 忽视小故障以后可能会导致高昂的维修费用。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可说明词语所指对象、在谈话中提及，或查阅资料。
example_en: In this report, the word youth will refer to people under twenty-five.
example_zh: 在本报告中，青年一词指二十五岁以下的人。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接职位、课程、许可或资金等希望获得的事物。
example_en: Eligible students may apply for financial support online.
example_zh: 符合条件的学生可以在线申请经济资助。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 在某种程度上；从某一角度看
usage_note_zh: 用于限定观点，说明陈述只在某个方面成立。
example_en: In a way, the unexpected delay gave us more time to prepare.
example_zh: 从某种角度看，意外的延误给了我们更多准备时间。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接作为依据、来源或原型的人或事物。
example_en: Scientific conclusions should be based on reliable evidence.
example_zh: 科学结论应该以可靠证据为基础。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指实际发生的生活和经历，与小说、网络或模拟环境相对。
example_en: Communication can be more complex in real life than in a textbook.
example_zh: 现实生活中的交流可能比课本中更复杂。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 与某事有关；与某人有亲属关系
usage_note_zh: 后接存在联系的人或事物，具体关系由语境决定。
example_en: The change may be related to a rise in water temperature.
example_zh: 这种变化可能与水温上升有关。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指用户创建、分享内容并进行社交互动的网络平台和服务。
example_en: Information on social media should be checked before it is shared.
example_zh: 社交媒体上的信息在分享前应该核实。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示努力没有取得预期结果，常与 try、attempt 等动词连用。
example_en: The rescue team searched in vain for a safe path through the snow.
example_zh: 救援队徒劳地寻找一条穿过雪地的安全道路。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示信息通过文字正式记录，而非只作口头说明。
example_en: Any change to the agreement must be confirmed in writing.
example_zh: 协议的任何变更都必须以书面形式确认。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示等待某事发生期间，另一件事正在进行。
example_en: The repairs will take two hours; in the meantime, passengers can use another entrance.
example_zh: 维修需要两小时，在此期间乘客可以使用另一个入口。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示以严肃认真的态度行动，或某事真正全面展开。
example_en: After weeks of planning, construction began in earnest.
example_zh: 经过数周规划，施工正式全面开始。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示为了不被发现或抓获而藏在某处。
example_en: The stolen painting remained in hiding for more than a decade.
example_zh: 这幅失窃的画作被隐藏了十多年。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示某个过程最初的阶段，后文常说明随后发生的变化。
example_en: In the beginning, few residents supported the proposal.
example_zh: 起初，很少有居民支持这项提议。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常指无需处方即可购买药品；作定语时通常写成 over-the-counter。
example_en: This medicine is available over the counter at most pharmacies.
example_zh: 这种药在大多数药店无需处方即可购买。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示可能因某个决定或事件而失去重要事物。
example_en: Thousands of jobs are at stake in the negotiations.
example_zh: 这场谈判关系到成千上万个工作岗位。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示不依靠现成材料或已有成果，从最基础的阶段开始。
example_en: The students built the simple robot from scratch.
example_zh: 学生们从零开始制作了这个简易机器人。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示因为时间紧迫而快速行动，有时暗示缺少充分考虑。
example_en: Decisions made in haste often create new problems.
example_zh: 匆忙作出的决定常常会带来新的问题。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 with 或 over 连用，表示人之间有分歧或事物彼此矛盾。
example_en: The two departments are at odds over how to divide the budget.
example_zh: 两个部门在如何分配预算的问题上存在分歧。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示方向上的往返，也可指意见或信息反复交换。
example_en: The two sides sent revised plans back and forth for weeks.
example_zh: 双方连续数周来回发送修改后的方案。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于列举末尾，表示还有其他同类事物未全部说出。
example_en: The workshop covers planning, budgeting, teamwork, and so forth.
example_zh: 研讨会涵盖规划、预算、团队合作等内容。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 非正式表达，表示不再需要承担责任、接受惩罚或面对难题。
example_en: The new evidence does not let the company off the hook.
example_zh: 新证据并不能让这家公司逃脱责任。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 通常用于 as a last resort，表示其他办法都无效后才采取的措施。
example_en: Closing the road should be a last resort.
example_zh: 封闭道路应该是最后的办法。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常用 no-nonsense 作定语；分开书写时可表示不接受借口或无意义行为。
example_en: Her message was clear: no nonsense would be tolerated during the exam.
example_zh: 她的信息很明确：考试期间不容许胡闹。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示在尚未仔细观察或深入思考时形成的第一印象。
example_en: At first glance, the two graphs appear almost identical.
example_zh: 乍一看，这两张图表几乎完全相同。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接法律、规则、原则或他人意愿，语气较正式。
example_en: The data must be stored in accordance with the new regulations.
example_zh: 这些数据必须按照新规定存储。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 就某方面而言；从某角度看
usage_note_zh: 用于限定比较、评价或讨论所依据的具体方面。
example_en: The two designs differ greatly in terms of cost and reliability.
example_zh: 这两种设计在成本和可靠性方面差异很大。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 较正式地引出要讨论、询问或说明的主题。
example_en: With regard to your application, we need one additional document.
example_zh: 关于你的申请，我们还需要一份文件。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示作为个人或组织的代表发言、行动，也可表示为了他人的利益。
example_en: On behalf of the volunteers, I would like to thank the local community.
example_zh: 我谨代表志愿者感谢当地社区。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于补充真实情况，常纠正或加强前面的说法。
example_en: As a matter of fact, the original plan was less expensive.
example_zh: 事实上，最初的方案成本更低。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示行动的目的在于帮助某人、保护某物或实现某个目标。
example_en: For the sake of safety, all visitors must wear a helmet.
example_zh: 为了安全，所有访客都必须佩戴头盔。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示赞成某项建议，也可说明选择一个方案而放弃另一个。
example_en: Most committee members voted in favor of the revised proposal.
example_zh: 大多数委员会成员投票支持修订后的提议。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 说明某人对某项工作、部门或人员负有管理责任。
example_en: A senior engineer is in charge of the safety inspection.
example_zh: 一名高级工程师负责安全检查。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接引起反应、回答或措施的事件和信息。
example_en: The city added more buses in response to public demand.
example_zh: 为回应公众需求，该市增加了公共汽车班次。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接比较对象，突出两者之间的明显差异。
example_en: In contrast to the coastal area, the inland region remained dry.
example_zh: 与沿海地区不同，内陆地区仍然干燥。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 关于；与某事相比；与某事有关
usage_note_zh: 用于说明讨论主题、相互联系或比较关系。
example_en: The report examines housing costs in relation to average income.
example_zh: 这份报告结合平均收入考察住房成本。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接名词、代词或动名词，表示结果不受所述困难影响。
example_en: In spite of heavy rain, the rescue operation continued.
example_zh: 尽管下着大雨，救援行动仍在继续。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 在某人或某物的帮助下
usage_note_zh: 后接提供帮助的人、工具或方法。
example_en: With the help of satellite images, researchers mapped the damaged area.
example_zh: 借助卫星图像，研究人员绘制了受损区域地图。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接不需要的人、物、习惯或问题。
example_en: The new filter can get rid of most harmful particles in the water.
example_zh: 这种新过滤器能够去除水中的大部分有害颗粒。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示不赞同某人或观点，也可指食物等使身体不适。
example_en: I disagree with the claim because the evidence is incomplete.
example_zh: 我不同意这一说法，因为证据并不完整。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 正式用语，可表示清楚陈述观点或规则，也可表示启程。
example_en: The document will set forth the principles of the agreement.
example_zh: 这份文件将阐明协议的原则。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 非正式用语，可表示快速做出食物，也可指激起强烈情绪。
example_en: The false report could whip up unnecessary fear.
example_zh: 这则虚假报道可能会煽动不必要的恐慌。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 with 连用，表示外观不显眼或人在群体中自然融入。
example_en: The building uses local stone to blend in with its surroundings.
example_zh: 这座建筑使用当地石材，以便与周围环境相协调。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 on 连用，表示当局采取强硬措施制止违法或有害行为。
example_en: The authorities promised to crack down on illegal dumping.
example_zh: 有关部门承诺严厉打击非法倾倒行为。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 of 连用，表示只在很短时间内看到某人或某物。
example_en: We managed to catch a glimpse of the rare bird before it flew away.
example_zh: 那只稀有鸟飞走前，我们设法瞥见了它。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示身体上紧紧抓住，也可指不愿放弃观念、希望或过去。
example_en: People sometimes cling to familiar routines during uncertain times.
example_zh: 在不确定的时期，人们有时会固守熟悉的日常习惯。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接规则、标准或普遍行为，表示与其一致。
example_en: All electrical equipment must conform to national safety standards.
example_zh: 所有电气设备都必须符合国家安全标准。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 非正式用语，可表示连接设备或系统；其他语境中也可能有不同含义。
example_en: A technician will hook up the new printer to the network.
example_zh: 技术人员会把新打印机连接到网络。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接某事物最早产生的地点、时期或环境。
example_en: The custom is believed to originate in a small mountain community.
example_zh: 人们认为这一习俗起源于一个小山村。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 非正式用语，表示短时间进入某处或拜访某人。
example_en: I may pop in after work to return your book.
example_zh: 我下班后可能会顺便来还你的书。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可指液体或材料吸收水分，也可比喻吸收知识或享受氛围。
example_en: Young children soak up new sounds remarkably quickly.
example_zh: 幼儿吸收新语音的速度非常快。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 on 连用，表示为将来需要提前储存足够的物品。
example_en: Residents began to stock up on drinking water before the storm.
example_zh: 暴风雨来临前，居民开始储备饮用水。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示意外碰见某人，也可指身体或物体碰撞。
example_en: I happened to bump into a former classmate at the conference.
example_zh: 我碰巧在会议上遇到一位以前的同学。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示擦净液体或处理剩余问题，也可指清除最后的抵抗。
example_en: Workers stayed behind to mop up the water after the pipe burst.
example_zh: 水管爆裂后，工人留下来把积水清理干净。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 确定；迫使明确表态；压制
usage_note_zh: 可表示获得准确细节，也可指迫使某人作出明确回答。
example_en: It is difficult to pin down the exact cause of the failure.
example_zh: 很难确定这次故障的确切原因。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 非正式用语，表示多人为共同任务贡献时间、劳动或金钱。
example_en: If everyone can pitch in, the hall will be ready by noon.
example_zh: 如果大家都来帮忙，大厅中午前就能准备好。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示问题或事物意外出现，也可指计算机窗口弹出。
example_en: Small problems often pop up during the testing stage.
example_zh: 测试阶段经常会突然出现一些小问题。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示通过摩擦去除，也常与 on 连用说明习惯或态度影响他人。
example_en: Her enthusiasm began to rub off on the rest of the team.
example_zh: 她的热情开始感染团队中的其他人。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 非正式用语，可接事情作宾语，也可单独表示表现失误。
example_en: One careless calculation could screw up the entire experiment.
example_zh: 一次粗心的计算就可能把整个实验弄糟。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示产生附带成果，也可指企业把部分业务分拆为独立公司。
example_en: The research project may spin off several practical inventions.
example_zh: 这个研究项目可能会衍生出几项实用发明。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 救助；帮助脱困；跳伞逃生
usage_note_zh: 可指提供资金或实际援助，也可非正式地表示退出困难局面。
example_en: The emergency loan was designed to bail out struggling small firms.
example_zh: 这笔紧急贷款旨在帮助经营困难的小企业脱困。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接废物、物品或问题；不能简单理解为“布置”。
example_en: Hospitals must dispose of medical waste safely.
example_zh: 医院必须安全处理医疗废物。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 擅长；在某方面表现出色
usage_note_zh: 后接名词或动名词，说明表现特别优秀的领域。
example_en: Students who excel at solving problems may enjoy this course.
example_zh: 擅长解决问题的学生可能会喜欢这门课程。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 on 或 against 连用，多指多人不公平地共同攻击或施压。
example_en: It is wrong to gang up on someone who holds a different opinion.
example_zh: 联合起来欺负持不同意见的人是不对的。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示用力或借助车辆把重物、垃圾等移走。
example_en: Workers will haul away the fallen branches after the storm.
example_zh: 暴风雨后，工人会运走倒下的树枝。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示用树篱围住，也可比喻规则或环境限制行动自由。
example_en: Strict regulations may hedge in the choices available to small firms.
example_zh: 严格规定可能会限制小企业可作出的选择。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示小物体嵌入某处，也可指想法或记忆牢牢留在脑中。
example_en: A tiny piece of glass can lodge in the skin.
example_zh: 一小片玻璃可能会嵌进皮肤里。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接名词或动名词，常指面对反对或困难仍继续某种行为。
example_en: If you persist in asking questions, you will eventually understand the topic.
example_zh: 如果你坚持提问，最终会理解这个主题。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 非正式用语，可表示某物突然脱出，也可指短时间离开。
example_en: One of the buttons may pop out if the case is closed too tightly.
example_zh: 如果盒子关得太紧，其中一个按钮可能会弹出来。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 较书面地表示液体、声音、光线或话语大量连续出现。
example_en: Warm light began to pour forth from the open doorway.
example_zh: 温暖的光线开始从敞开的门口倾泻而出。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示提供信息或证据，帮助人们理解复杂或未知的问题。
example_en: The new evidence may shed light on the cause of the accident.
example_zh: 新证据可能有助于查明事故原因。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示从狭窄空间通过，也可指以很小优势或勉强达到标准。
example_en: We had to squeeze by the crowd near the entrance.
example_zh: 我们不得不从入口附近的人群中挤过去。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示通过吸力吸收液体，也可与 to 连用表示讨好有权势者。
example_en: The dry ground can suck up a surprising amount of rainwater.
example_zh: 干燥的地面能吸收数量惊人的雨水。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接遭遇困难的人，或表示理解某种观点和感受。
example_en: Many readers sympathize with the character's difficult choice.
example_zh: 许多读者同情这个人物所面临的艰难选择。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 非正式用语，表示受邀或未经特别邀请而跟随他人同行。
example_en: My younger brother asked if he could tag along on our hike.
example_zh: 我弟弟问能否跟我们一起徒步。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 彻底消灭；摧毁；使筋疲力尽
usage_note_zh: 可表示完全清除群体或事物，也可非正式地表示使人非常疲惫。
example_en: A single disease could wipe out the entire crop.
example_zh: 一种疾病就可能毁掉全部庄稼。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示请求不参加活动或不履行原先承担的责任。
example_en: She had to beg off the trip because of a family emergency.
example_zh: 由于家庭突发情况，她不得不请求不参加这次旅行。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指火箭或航天器点火后离开地面。
example_en: The rocket is scheduled to blast off just before sunrise.
example_zh: 火箭计划在日出前发射升空。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 非正式用语，用于鼓励某人改善情绪或更加努力。
example_en: Buck up; one disappointing result does not define your ability.
example_zh: 振作起来，一次令人失望的结果并不能定义你的能力。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 to 连用，表示不再拖延并专心投入任务。
example_en: We need to buckle down and finish the report before Friday.
example_zh: 我们需要认真投入，在星期五前完成报告。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示多穿衣服保暖，也可表示把物品扎成一捆。
example_en: Bundle up before you go outside in the snow.
example_zh: 去雪地里之前要穿暖和。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 非正式用语，表示找借口逃避应该面对的任务或决定。
example_en: Refusing to vote would be an easy way to cop out.
example_zh: 拒绝投票会成为一种轻易逃避责任的方式。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 捧腹大笑；精神崩溃；撞毁
usage_note_zh: 含义取决于语境，可表示突然大笑或无法承受压力。
example_en: His imitation made the entire audience crack up.
example_zh: 他的模仿让全场观众捧腹大笑。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示身体蜷成舒适或保护姿势，也可指纸张边缘卷起。
example_en: The cat likes to curl up beside the warm window.
example_zh: 这只猫喜欢蜷缩在温暖的窗边。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示在餐馆而不是在家里吃正餐。
example_en: Many families dine out to celebrate special occasions.
example_zh: 许多家庭会外出就餐庆祝特殊日子。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可指声音或画面逐渐变弱，也可指某事物慢慢停止出现。
example_en: The music will fade out at the end of the scene.
example_zh: 这一幕结束时音乐会渐渐淡出。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 反复协商后达成；认真制定
usage_note_zh: 表示经过艰苦讨论或努力，最终形成协议、计划或解决方案。
example_en: The two groups met overnight to hammer out an agreement.
example_zh: 两个团体彻夜会谈，以达成协议。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 of 连用，表示主动选择不参与某项安排或制度。
example_en: Participants may opt out of the study at any time.
example_zh: 参与者可以随时选择退出这项研究。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 非正式用语，常指累积得分、债务、费用或成就。
example_en: The new train service continues to rack up operating losses.
example_zh: 新的列车服务持续累积运营亏损。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示认为某事不重要而忽略，也可指摆脱疾病或负面影响。
example_en: She tried to shrug off the criticism and focus on her work.
example_zh: 她努力不理会批评，专注于自己的工作。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可指液体溢出容器，也可表示问题、冲突或影响扩展到其他领域。
example_en: The dispute could spill over into neighboring regions.
example_zh: 这场争端可能会波及邻近地区。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示使过程持续过久，也可指车辆打转失控。
example_en: The lawyers tried to spin out the negotiations for another week.
example_zh: 律师们试图把谈判再拖延一周。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示引发麻烦或强烈情绪，也可按字面搅动沉积物。
example_en: Careless comments can stir up unnecessary conflict.
example_zh: 草率的评论可能会挑起不必要的冲突。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示解决混乱或误会，也可指把弯曲物弄直。
example_en: A brief meeting should straighten out the misunderstanding.
example_zh: 一次简短的会面应该能消除误会。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示把房间收拾整齐，也可指改善姿势。
example_en: Please straighten up the classroom before the visitors arrive.
example_zh: 访客到来前请整理好教室。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 发誓不再使用或做某事
usage_note_zh: 后接要戒除的物品或习惯，表示郑重决定停止。
example_en: After the sleepless night, he decided to swear off late coffee.
example_zh: 经历了失眠的一夜后，他决定发誓不再深夜喝咖啡。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示提供暂时的金钱、物资或支持，使人撑过困难时期，宾语通常放在 tide 与 over 之间。
example_en: This small loan should tide the shop over until sales improve.
example_zh: 这笔小额贷款应该能帮助商店撑到销售好转。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 非正式用语，可表示不费力地完成作品，也可表示随手扔掉或快速喝下。
example_en: An experienced writer may toss off a short review in an hour.
example_zh: 经验丰富的作家可能一小时就能迅速写完一篇短评。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接合作的个人、团体或国家，表示为共同目标建立联盟。
example_en: The smaller parties may ally with one another after the election.
example_zh: 较小的政党可能在选举后相互结盟。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 非正式用语，表示快速而用力地完成文字或音乐。
example_en: She can bang out a clear first draft before lunch.
example_zh: 她能在午饭前迅速写出一份清楚的初稿。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示通过讨价还价使卖方接受更低价格。
example_en: The buyer managed to bargain down the price of the used bicycle.
example_zh: 买方成功把这辆二手自行车的价格讲低了。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示迅速离开危险或尴尬局面，语气可正式也可幽默。
example_en: The hikers had to beat a retreat when the storm approached.
example_zh: 暴风雨临近时，徒步者不得不撤退。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 非正式表达，表示为帮助或取悦某人付出格外努力。
example_en: The staff bend over backwards to make every visitor feel welcome.
example_zh: 工作人员竭尽全力让每位访客感到宾至如归。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 轻松通过；毫不费力地完成
usage_note_zh: 表示快速、顺利地完成考试、任务或过程。
example_en: With careful preparation, she was able to breeze through the interview.
example_zh: 经过认真准备，她轻松通过了面试。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 较正式用语，可表示产生结果、提出想法或使某物出现。
example_en: Open discussion can bring forth unexpected solutions.
example_zh: 开放的讨论能够产生意想不到的解决方案。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 with 连用，表示情绪强烈到明显流露，也可按字面指液体溢出。
example_en: The children began to bubble over with excitement before the trip.
example_zh: 旅行前，孩子们兴奋得难以抑制。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示气泡或液体升到表面，也可比喻想法或情绪出现。
example_en: New questions often bubble up during an open discussion.
example_zh: 开放讨论中经常会涌现新的问题。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 under pressure 连用，表示在压力或重负下让步或崩溃。
example_en: The committee refused to buckle under political pressure.
example_zh: 委员会拒绝在政治压力下屈服。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 非正式用语，表示使价格、数量或级别上升。
example_en: A shortage of parts may bump up production costs.
example_zh: 零部件短缺可能会提高生产成本。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 较书面地表示声音、光线、液体或情感突然强烈出现。
example_en: Laughter began to burst forth from the crowded room.
example_zh: 笑声开始从拥挤的房间里迸发出来。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示把沉重、大量或不需要的物品装车移走。
example_en: Workers arrived to cart away the broken furniture.
example_zh: 工人们前来运走损坏的家具。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 较正式地表示使某种反应、情感、能力或努力显现出来。
example_en: A crisis can call forth unexpected courage in ordinary people.
example_zh: 危机能够激发普通人意想不到的勇气。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 on 或 about 连用，指长时间自信地谈论某个主题，有时含轻微批评。
example_en: He began to hold forth on the future of artificial intelligence.
example_zh: 他开始滔滔不绝地谈论人工智能的未来。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 积极投入；猛烈批评或攻击
usage_note_zh: 非正式用语，可表示热情开始工作，也可指严厉攻击某人或观点。
example_en: Volunteers were ready to pitch into the cleanup after the storm.
example_zh: 志愿者们准备积极投入暴风雨后的清理工作。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示用毛巾擦干身体、按摩肌肉，或摩擦物体表面使其平滑。
example_en: Athletes often rub down tired muscles after intense exercise.
example_zh: 运动员剧烈运动后常常按摩疲劳的肌肉。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示用摩擦方式去除铅笔字或痕迹；某些非正式语境也可指杀害。
example_en: Use a soft eraser to rub out the pencil marks.
example_zh: 用柔软的橡皮擦掉铅笔痕迹。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 非正式用语，表示通过撞击把车辆或物品严重损坏。
example_en: The falling branch could smash up any car parked below.
example_zh: 掉落的树枝可能会砸坏停在下面的任何汽车。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 坚持原有立场；拒绝改变
usage_note_zh: 主要用于美式英语，表示在出现压力或新情况时仍维持原决定。
example_en: The board chose to stand pat and make no further changes.
example_zh: 董事会选择维持原决定，不再作进一步改变。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示逐项标记或列举；非正式语境也可表示使人生气。
example_en: Please tick off each item after you inspect it.
example_zh: 检查完每一项后请打勾。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示穿过障碍，也可指克服限制或取得重大进展。
example_en: Researchers hope to break through the technical barrier this year.
example_zh: 研究人员希望今年突破这项技术障碍。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示提出话题、养育孩子，也可描述身体把食物吐出。
example_en: She plans to bring up the funding issue at the next meeting.
example_zh: 她计划在下次会议上提出资金问题。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常用于询问或解释某种情况、变化是怎样发生的。
example_en: How did such a major change come about so quickly?
example_zh: 如此重大的变化是怎样迅速发生的？

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 脱落；成功；给人某种印象
usage_note_zh: 可表示从表面脱离、计划取得成功，也可与 as 连用说明给人的感觉。
example_en: The label should come off easily in warm water.
example_zh: 这个标签在温水里应该很容易脱落。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示打断谈话、车辆突然并线，也可指机器自动开始运转。
example_en: It is impolite to cut in while someone else is speaking.
example_zh: 别人说话时插嘴是不礼貌的。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 of 连用，表示在完成前退出课程、比赛或某项活动。
example_en: Financial pressure may force some students to drop out of college.
example_zh: 经济压力可能迫使一些学生大学辍学。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示进度或成绩落后于他人，也可指付款没有按时完成。
example_en: Students who miss several classes may fall behind quickly.
example_zh: 缺几次课的学生可能很快落后。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示成功传达观点，也可表示从一边到另一边。
example_en: A simple diagram can help get across a complex idea.
example_zh: 一张简单的图可以帮助讲清复杂的概念。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示移动、规避规则，也可指消息广泛传播。
example_en: There is no safe way to get around the regulation.
example_zh: 没有安全的办法规避这项规定。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 on 连用说明靠有限资源生活，也可指勉强达到要求。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

example_zh: 记日记可能有助于提高自我认知。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

example_zh: 经常练习帮助她建立了自信。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

example_zh: 争论时保持冷静需要自制力。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

example_zh: 旅行成了这位年轻艺术家的自我发现之旅。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
