example_zh: 如果供应仍然有限，价格很可能上涨。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接可获得的信息、服务、场所或资源。
example_en: Every student should have access to a quiet place to study.
example_zh: 每名学生都应该有安静的学习场所可用。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接可以用来实现目的的资源、机会或信息。
example_en: The design makes use of natural light to reduce energy use.
example_zh: 这项设计利用自然光来降低能耗。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接过程、结果或活动，说明参与其中或产生影响。
example_en: Trust can play a role in the success of a team.
example_zh: 信任能够在团队成功中发挥作用。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示说明原因，也可表示构成总数中的某一部分。
example_en: Online sales now account for half of the company's income.
example_zh: 线上销售目前占该公司收入的一半。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接计划、任务、调查或实验，表示把它付诸行动。
example_en: Independent experts will carry out the safety review.
example_zh: 独立专家将开展安全审查。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接需要投入主要注意力或讨论的对象。
example_en: The workshop will focus on communication skills.
example_zh: 这次研讨会将重点讲解沟通技能。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示取得控制权、责任或接替某人的工作。
example_en: A younger team will take over management of the project next year.
example_zh: 一个更年轻的团队明年将接管这个项目。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示经营某类商品，也可表示交回旧物并抵扣新物价格。
example_en: The company used to trade in agricultural machinery.
example_zh: 这家公司过去经营农业机械。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示持续留意并保护某人、动物或地方。
example_en: Park rangers watch over the nesting birds during spring.
example_zh: 公园巡护员春季守护筑巢的鸟类。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接角色、职务或功能，表示临时或实际发挥该作用。
example_en: This open area can act as an emergency meeting point.
example_zh: 这片开阔区域可以充当紧急集合点。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常见于疑问结构 what to do with，也可用于 have something to do with。
example_en: What should we do with equipment that no longer works?
example_zh: 我们应该如何处理不再工作的设备？

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 竞选；赶去；持续一段时间
usage_note_zh: 可表示竞选职位、跑向某处，或演出和活动持续多久。
example_en: She plans to run for class president next term.
example_zh: 她计划下学期竞选班长。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 以某事为中心；集中讨论
usage_note_zh: 后接活动、故事或讨论的核心主题，美式拼写为 center。
example_en: The conference will center on solutions to urban water shortages.
example_zh: 会议将集中讨论城市缺水的解决方案。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示仔细了解问题、事件或可能性，以查明事实。
example_en: The committee agreed to look into the cause of the delay.
example_zh: 委员会同意调查延误的原因。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 对某事负责；因某事受惩罚
usage_note_zh: 表示必须为行为、错误或结果承担责任并作出解释。
example_en: Managers must answer for decisions made under their authority.
example_zh: 管理人员必须为其职权范围内作出的决定负责。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可指战争、火灾或疾病突然出现，也可指从受控地点逃出。
example_en: A fire could break out if the damaged wire is not replaced.
example_zh: 如果不更换损坏的电线，可能会发生火灾。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示引入制度或人才、获得收入，或请某人参与处理。
example_en: The hospital plans to bring in an expert to review the case.
example_zh: 医院计划请一名专家来复核这个病例。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可指设备因过度使用损坏，也可指人长期承受压力后身心疲惫。
example_en: Employees may burn out when heavy workloads continue for months.
example_zh: 繁重工作持续数月时，员工可能会身心俱疲。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 恢复知觉；改变看法；顺便来访
usage_note_zh: 含义取决于语境，也可表示某个固定时间再次到来。
example_en: He may come around once he has considered all the evidence.
example_zh: 他考虑完所有证据后可能会改变看法。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示隐瞒错误或事实，也可指用物品覆盖身体或表面。
example_en: Officials must not cover up mistakes in the investigation.
example_zh: 官员不得掩盖调查中的错误。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示因外观、能力或特点而容易被注意到。
example_en: A clear opening sentence can make your essay stand out.
example_zh: 清楚的开头句能够让你的文章脱颖而出。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示提高行动力度或数量，也可指走上前承担责任。
example_en: The city must step up efforts to repair unsafe housing.
example_zh: 这座城市必须加大力度维修不安全的住房。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 for 连用，表示登记参加课程、活动或服务。
example_en: More than two hundred residents sign up for the program each year.
example_zh: 每年有二百多名居民报名参加这个项目。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示利用经验或资源，也可指时间逐渐过去或某个时刻临近。
example_en: Good leaders draw on the knowledge of the whole team.
example_zh: 优秀的领导者会利用整个团队的知识。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示在事业、学习或竞争中进展并获得较好位置。
example_en: People should not need personal connections to get ahead.
example_zh: 人们不应该必须依靠私人关系才能获得成功。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接名词或动名词，表示以某种方式开始和处理事情。
example_en: We need to go about the task in a more organized way.
example_zh: 我们需要以更有条理的方式着手处理这项任务。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示使进程推迟、支撑某物，也可指举起物品。
example_en: A missing permit could hold up construction for weeks.
example_zh: 缺少许可证可能使施工延误数周。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常表示因经营原因裁员；非正式语境也可表示停止某种行为。
example_en: The factory may lay off workers if orders continue to fall.
example_zh: 如果订单继续减少，这家工厂可能会裁员。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接被认为地位、能力或价值较低的人或事物。
example_en: No one should look down on people because of their occupation.
example_zh: 任何人都不应因为职业而轻视别人。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 with 连用，表示在资源不足时用现有条件应付。
example_en: Until the new desks arrive, we will make do with the old ones.
example_zh: 新课桌到达之前，我们只好用旧课桌将就。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 在……之中；正当某事进行时
usage_note_zh: 通常与 of 连用，表示处于某个地方、群体或过程的中间。
example_en: The company changed its strategy in the midst of a financial crisis.
example_zh: 这家公司在金融危机期间改变了战略。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 通常作表语，表示某种风格、观念或做法在当前广受欢迎。
example_en: Minimalist design is once again in vogue.
example_zh: 极简设计再次流行起来。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示尚未仔细研究时形成的第一印象，语气较书面。
example_en: At first blush, the proposal seems fair to everyone.
example_zh: 乍一看，这项提议似乎对所有人都公平。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可说明实际结果，也可表示法律、规则或制度正在有效实施。
example_en: The new rule is already in effect across the organization.
example_zh: 这项新规定已经在整个组织内生效。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示没有公众或无关人员在场时进行谈话或活动。
example_en: The two leaders continued their discussion in private.
example_zh: 两位领导人私下继续讨论。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 较书面地用于强调真实情况，尤其当它与表象或说法不同。
example_en: In truth, the apparent success depended on years of preparation.
example_zh: 事实上，表面上的成功依靠的是多年的准备。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于承认某一点成立，后文常补充限制或不同看法。
example_en: To be sure, the plan is ambitious, but it is not impossible.
example_zh: 诚然，这项计划雄心勃勃，但并非不可能。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 在逃；总体而言；自由活动
usage_note_zh: 含义随语境变化，可指未被捕获，也可指整个社会或群体。
example_en: The report examines the effects of automation on society at large.
example_zh: 这份报告考察自动化对整个社会的影响。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示能够在任何想要的时候自由行动或改变。
example_en: Authorized users can adjust the settings at will.
example_zh: 获授权的用户可以随意调整设置。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于说明可能出现的最不利结果。
example_en: At worst, the delay will add two days to the journey.
example_zh: 最坏的情况下，延误会使行程增加两天。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于综合考虑各方面后作出总体评价。
example_en: All in all, the experiment produced more useful data than expected.
example_zh: 总的来说，这次实验产生的有用数据比预期更多。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示事情出乎意料地迅速发生。
example_en: All of a sudden, the lights went out and the room fell silent.
example_zh: 突然，灯熄灭了，房间安静下来。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于补充一个使前述观点更明显或更有说服力的事实。
example_en: The route is long and steep, not to mention dangerous after dark.
example_zh: 这条路线又长又陡，更不用说天黑后还很危险。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 非正式表达，表示程度接近完全或情况大体如此。
example_en: The repairs are pretty much complete, apart from some painting.
example_zh: 除了部分粉刷工作，维修已经差不多完成了。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于用更清楚或更准确的话重新解释前面的内容。
example_en: The material is biodegradable; that is to say, it can break down naturally.
example_zh: 这种材料可生物降解，也就是说，它能自然分解。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 大体上；在大多数情况下
usage_note_zh: 表示陈述对绝大部分情况成立，但可能存在例外。
example_en: For the most part, the two studies reached similar conclusions.
example_zh: 总体而言，这两项研究得出了相似结论。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 多用于否定句或疑问句，表示截至现在某事尚未发生。
example_en: No reliable explanation has emerged as yet.
example_zh: 到目前为止尚未出现可靠的解释。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示某种特点是天然具有的，而非后来形成或暂时出现。
example_en: The material is flexible by nature but becomes hard in cold weather.
example_zh: 这种材料本身具有柔韧性，但在寒冷天气中会变硬。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于给出一组数值或情况的平均结果，不代表每个个体都相同。
example_en: The journey takes forty minutes on average.
example_zh: 这段行程平均需要四十分钟。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 通常与现在完成时连用，说明从过去到当前时点的累计情况。
example_en: This is the largest survey conducted to date.
example_zh: 这是迄今开展的最大规模调查。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示某种状态或行动不会再改变或恢复。
example_en: The factory closed for good after its final order was completed.
example_zh: 完成最后一笔订单后，这家工厂永久关闭了。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于否定或限制性陈述后，强调后一件事更加不可能或更困难。
example_en: The shelter lacks basic heating, let alone modern medical equipment.
example_zh: 这个避难所连基本供暖都没有，更不用说现代医疗设备了。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示在主要工作之外进行，也可表示额外提供或放在旁边。
example_en: She translates technical articles on the side.
example_zh: 她兼职翻译技术文章。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常用于 evidence to the contrary，表示与前述说法相矛盾。
example_en: Despite claims to the contrary, the lake has not fully recovered.
example_zh: 尽管有相反说法，这座湖泊尚未完全恢复。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 作副词时常写作 head-on 或 head on，表示直接面对冲突、问题或撞击。
example_en: The committee decided to address the controversy head on.
example_zh: 委员会决定正面处理这场争议。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可按字面表示书面记录，也可指方案理论上可行但实际情况未必如此。
example_en: The system looks efficient on paper but is difficult to operate.
example_zh: 这个系统在纸面上看起来高效，实际却很难操作。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示某事没有预先安排或明确原因而发生。
example_en: We discovered the error by chance while checking another file.
example_zh: 我们检查另一个文件时偶然发现了这个错误。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示某人隐藏在表面态度之下的真实感受或认识。
example_en: Deep down, he knew that the decision had been unfair.
example_zh: 在内心深处，他知道这个决定并不公平。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于承认前述情况后，指出结果或观点仍然没有改变。
example_en: The evidence is limited; even so, it deserves careful examination.
example_zh: 证据有限；即便如此，仍值得认真研究。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示对事实有把握，常用于 know 或 say 等动词后。
example_en: We cannot know for certain how the ancient structure was built.
example_zh: 我们无法确切知道这座古代建筑是如何建造的。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示情况在当前时点成立，但以后可能改变。
example_en: For the moment, the damaged road remains closed.
example_zh: 目前，受损道路仍然封闭。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 search 或 look 连用，强调在许多地方彻底寻找。
example_en: We searched high and low for the missing document.
example_zh: 我们到处寻找那份丢失的文件。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 with 连用，表示个人或组织协调行动；也可按字面指在音乐会上。
example_en: Several agencies worked in concert to restore essential services.
example_zh: 多个机构协同工作，恢复基本服务。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示无论其他情况如何，某个结论或行动仍然成立。
example_en: In any case, the data should be backed up before the upgrade.
example_zh: 无论如何，升级前都应该备份数据。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 通常用于否定句或疑问句，加强任何微小程度都不存在的含义。
example_en: The unexpected question did not trouble her in the least.
example_zh: 这个意外问题一点也没有难住她。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示衣物内外翻转，也可比喻对某事了解得非常透彻。
example_en: The sudden wind turned my umbrella inside out.
example_zh: 一阵突如其来的风把我的伞吹翻了。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示某事在一段时间内时而发生、时而停止。
example_en: It rained off and on throughout the afternoon.
example_zh: 整个下午雨断断续续地下。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示某事间隔较长时间发生一次。
example_en: Even experts make simple mistakes once in a while.
example_zh: 即使专家偶尔也会犯简单错误。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示位置偏远、移开障碍，或困难任务已经解决。
example_en: The village is beautiful but rather out of the way.
example_zh: 这个村庄很美，但位置相当偏僻。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 强调同一事情连续多日反复发生，有时暗示单调或坚持。
example_en: The researchers recorded temperature changes day after day.
example_zh: 研究人员日复一日地记录温度变化。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 强调同一动作或情况发生很多次。
example_en: The same warning appeared again and again in the records.
example_zh: 同一条警告在记录中反复出现。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 强调在长时间等待、努力或延误之后某事终于发生。
example_en: At long last, the two sides reached an agreement.
example_zh: 经过漫长等待，双方终于达成协议。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示即使按最乐观估计，结果也只能达到某个有限程度。
example_en: The repairs will take a week at best.
example_zh: 即使在最好的情况下，维修也需要一周。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 用于比较级或最高级前后，加强差距很大的含义。
example_en: This is by far the most detailed map of the region.
example_zh: 这是目前这一区域最详尽的地图。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示没有删减、折扣或遗漏，常与 pay、publish、describe 等动词连用。
example_en: The interview will be published in full next week.
example_zh: 这篇访谈将于下周全文发表。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 通常作表语或状语；underway 也常见，尤其作定语时。
example_en: A major review of the safety rules is now under way.
example_zh: 对安全规定的大规模审查正在进行中。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接令人不快或已发生的事情，表示花过多时间思考或谈论。
example_en: There is little value in continuing to dwell on past mistakes.
example_zh: 继续纠结过去的错误没有多大价值。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接重要的新计划、事业、课程或旅程，语气较正式。
example_en: The university will embark on a ten-year research program.
example_zh: 这所大学将启动一项为期十年的研究计划。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 与某物碰撞；与某观点冲突
usage_note_zh: 可按字面表示物体相撞，也可比喻利益、观点或计划发生冲突。
example_en: The satellite could collide with a piece of space debris.
example_zh: 这颗卫星可能与一块太空碎片相撞。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 名词短语，表示长期而艰难地寻找答案、目标或重要事物。
example_en: The scientist devoted her career to the quest for a safer material.
example_zh: 这位科学家把职业生涯投入到寻找更安全材料的探索中。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接法律、规则、决定或协议，语气较正式。
example_en: All participants must abide by the competition rules.
example_zh: 所有参赛者都必须遵守比赛规则。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 on 连用，表示当局采取强硬措施制止某种活动。
example_en: Regulators plan to clamp down on misleading advertisements.
example_zh: 监管机构计划严厉打击误导性广告。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接想法或可能性，常用于否定结构说明某事难以想象。
example_en: It is difficult to conceive of modern life without electricity.
example_zh: 很难想象没有电的现代生活。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示把金钱、食物、任务或惩罚分成若干份发给不同的人。
example_en: Volunteers began to dole out blankets to the waiting families.
example_zh: 志愿者开始向等候的家庭逐一发放毯子。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示无意中或短暂地进入睡眠，常发生在坐着时。
example_en: He began to doze off during the long train journey.
example_zh: 在漫长的火车旅途中，他开始打瞌睡。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示花比通常更多的时间做某事，常因享受或犹豫而不愿结束。
example_en: We decided to linger over coffee and continue the discussion.
example_zh: 我们决定慢慢喝咖啡，继续讨论。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 原指勒紧缰绳，常比喻控制开支、权力、情绪或过度行为。
example_en: The company introduced new rules to rein in unnecessary spending.
example_zh: 公司出台新规定以控制不必要的开支。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示凭很少的金钱、能力或优势艰难达到最低要求。
example_en: The family managed to scrape by on a very limited income.
example_zh: 这个家庭靠非常有限的收入勉强维持生活。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示酒精影响减弱，也可比喻从兴奋或幻想中恢复理智。
example_en: It may take several hours to sober up completely.
example_zh: 完全醒酒可能需要几个小时。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 非正式用语，表示不礼貌地打断谈话或介入别人的事务。
example_en: Please do not butt in while the witness is answering.
example_zh: 证人回答时请不要插嘴。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 非正式用语，可表示提高价格或数量，也可指用千斤顶抬起车辆。
example_en: A sudden shortage could jack up fuel prices.
example_zh: 突然的短缺可能会大幅推高燃料价格。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 非正式用语，可表示损坏物品、驱散团体或使关系破裂。
example_en: Police arrived to bust up the illegal gathering.
example_zh: 警察赶到并驱散了非法集会。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 非正式且不礼貌的表达，用于命令某人离开。
example_en: He told the reporters to buzz off and leave the family alone.
example_zh: 他让记者们走开，不要打扰这家人。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可指疾病、冲突或情绪突然恶化，也可指火焰猛然燃起。
example_en: Old tensions may flare up if the talks fail.
example_zh: 如果谈判失败，旧有紧张局势可能突然加剧。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 非正式用语，表示错误或干扰使计划、机器或过程无法正常进行。
example_en: Incorrect data could foul up the entire calculation.
example_zh: 错误数据可能会把整个计算弄乱。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示在正式生产前制作外观或功能的试验版本；名词通常写作 mock-up。
example_en: The designers will mock up three versions of the new interface.
example_zh: 设计师将制作三个版本的新界面样稿。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可按字面表示割倒植物，也可指车辆或武器造成多人伤亡。
example_en: The machine can mow down tall grass in a few minutes.
example_zh: 这台机器几分钟内就能割倒高草。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示表层脱落、除去衣物，也可指车辆或人员从群体中分离。
example_en: The old paint began to peel off the wooden door.
example_zh: 旧油漆开始从木门上剥落。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示获得准确细节，也可指用木桩等把物品固定在地面。
example_en: We need to peg down the exact delivery date before signing.
example_zh: 签字前我们需要确定确切的交付日期。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示毫不费力地连续背诵或列出大量信息。
example_en: She can reel off the names of every winner since 1990.
example_zh: 她能一口气说出自 1990 年以来每位获胜者的名字。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示利用手边材料快速搭建或连接临时装置。
example_en: The crew managed to rig up a temporary radio antenna.
example_zh: 工作人员设法临时架设了一根无线电天线。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 非正式用语，可表示启程，也可用作不礼貌的逐客命令。
example_en: We should shove off before the tide begins to fall.
example_zh: 我们应该在退潮前离岸出发。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示因机会难得而很快购买、接受或取得某物。
example_en: Investors were quick to snap up the newly issued shares.
example_zh: 投资者迅速抢购了新发行的股票。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可指动物凭嗅觉找到目标，也可比喻通过调查发现隐藏信息。
example_en: Skilled investigators can sniff out inconsistencies in a false account.
example_zh: 经验丰富的调查人员能发现虚假陈述中的矛盾。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 动词也常写作 soft-pedal，表示故意弱化问题的重要性或严重程度。
example_en: Officials should not soft pedal the risks described in the report.
example_zh: 官员不应淡化报告中所述的风险。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 睁一只眼闭一只眼；默许
usage_note_zh: 比喻故意不制止或不惩罚自己知道的不当行为。
example_en: An effective regulator cannot wink at repeated safety violations.
example_zh: 有效的监管机构不能纵容反复发生的安全违规行为。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 坚持表达自己的权利或意见
usage_note_zh: 表示以自信而明确的方式维护立场，通常不等同于攻击他人。
example_en: It can be difficult to assert oneself in a formal meeting.
example_zh: 在正式会议中坚定表达自己的意见可能并不容易。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示未经允许突然进入，或粗鲁地打断谈话。
example_en: He apologized for choosing to barge in without knocking.
example_zh: 他为自己没敲门就闯入而道歉。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可按字面表示电路保险丝熔断，也可非正式地形容突然大怒。
example_en: My supervisor will blow a fuse if the figures are missing again.
example_zh: 如果数据再次缺失，我的主管会大发雷霆。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 反身代词随主语变化，后接预期会发生的冲击、坏消息或困难。
example_en: It is wise to brace oneself for possible delays during the storm.
example_zh: 明智的做法是做好准备，应对暴风雨期间可能出现的延误。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 较正式地表示为作决定或解决问题而交换意见。
example_en: The judge will confer with both lawyers before setting a date.
example_zh: 法官确定日期前将与双方律师商议。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 to 连用，表示为获得利益而刻意与有影响力者建立亲近关系。
example_en: The company tried to cozy up to local officials before the vote.
example_zh: 这家公司试图在投票前讨好当地官员。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接贷款、债务或合同义务，表示没有按约定付款或履责。
example_en: The firm may default on its loans if sales continue to decline.
example_zh: 如果销售继续下降，这家公司可能会拖欠贷款。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示决定不用通常需要的人、物或程序；也可表示处理掉。
example_en: The revised process will dispense with several unnecessary forms.
example_zh: 修订后的流程将省去几份不必要的表格。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示迅速而用力地除去衣物、束缚或影响。
example_en: He began to fling off his wet coat as soon as he entered.
example_zh: 他一进门就开始迅速脱掉湿外套。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 突然失去冷静；非常激动
usage_note_zh: 非正式用语，表示因愤怒、恐惧或兴奋而反应强烈。
example_en: Some investors may flip out when prices change sharply.
example_zh: 价格剧烈变化时，一些投资者可能会失去冷静。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示使物体转到另一面，也可指车辆翻覆。
example_en: Use a wide tool to flip over the pancake.
example_zh: 用宽一点的工具把薄饼翻面。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 调情；轻率考虑；冒险接近
usage_note_zh: 可表示以言行表达浪漫兴趣，也可比喻短暂考虑想法或接近危险。
example_en: The proposal appears to flirt with an idea rejected years ago.
example_zh: 这项提议似乎在试探一个多年前被否决的想法。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示社会、组织或个人认为某种行为不合适，但未必正式禁止。
example_en: Most employers frown on sharing confidential information.
example_zh: 大多数雇主不赞成分享保密信息。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指月球运行到太阳与地球之间，从地球上看太阳被部分或全部遮挡的现象。
example_en: The next solar eclipse will be visible only from a narrow region.
example_zh: 下一次日食只能从一个狭窄地区看到。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 to 连用，表示公开释放愤怒、挫折或其他强烈情感。
example_en: The editorial gave residents a place to give vent to their frustration.
example_zh: 这篇社论给居民提供了表达不满的空间。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示在黑暗中用手摸索，也可比喻艰难寻找词语、答案或办法。
example_en: The speaker paused to grope for the right words.
example_zh: 演讲者停下来，努力寻找恰当的措辞。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示结果完全或主要依赖某个条件、决定或事实。
example_en: The success of the rescue may hinge on accurate weather forecasts.
example_zh: 救援能否成功可能取决于准确的天气预报。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示为取暖或安全而靠近，也可指小群人聚在一起讨论。
example_en: The hikers had to huddle together for warmth.
example_zh: 徒步者不得不挤在一起取暖。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 通常与 of 连用，表示持续了解某领域的变化和新信息。
example_en: Doctors must keep abreast of new research in their field.
example_zh: 医生必须跟上本领域的最新研究。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 at 连用，表示因愤怒或受压而突然用言语或行动攻击。
example_en: People under severe stress may lash out at those trying to help.
example_zh: 承受巨大压力的人可能会攻击试图帮助他们的人。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 把某人引入歧途；使误判
usage_note_zh: 表示使人采取错误行为，或让人的判断偏离事实。
example_en: A single dramatic example can lead astray readers who ignore the wider evidence.
example_zh: 一个引人注目的个例可能会误导忽视更广泛证据的读者。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 非正式用语，表示长时间坐着或躺着，几乎不做什么事情。
example_en: We had no time to lounge around before the afternoon session.
example_zh: 下午场开始前，我们没有时间闲待。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可作名词或动词，指被告认罪以换取控罪或刑罚方面让步的司法安排。
example_en: A defendant may plea bargain to avoid the uncertainty of a trial.
example_zh: 被告可能通过辩诉交易来避免审判结果的不确定性。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指儿童因暂时不能由原生家庭照顾，而由经安排的家庭或机构提供生活照护的制度。
example_en: Stable foster care can give a child safety during a family crisis.
example_zh: 稳定的寄养照护能够在家庭危机期间为儿童提供安全保障。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可按字面表示用物体撑住，也可比喻用资金或政策维持薄弱事物。
example_en: Temporary beams will prop up the damaged roof.
example_zh: 临时横梁将支撑受损的屋顶。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指职位仅次于总统或总裁的人，具体职责随政府或组织而异。
example_en: The vice president will lead the negotiations overseas.
example_zh: 副总统将负责领导海外谈判。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示经过努力凑足少量金钱、资源或支持。
example_en: The community managed to scrape up enough money to repair the hall.
example_zh: 社区设法凑够了维修大厅的钱。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示从液体表面去除一层，也可比喻取走利润或最优资源。
example_en: Use a spoon to skim off the foam from the surface.
example_zh: 用勺子撇去表面的泡沫。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示只看主要内容而不研究细节，也可指在表面轻快移动。
example_en: Do not merely skim over the evidence before reaching a conclusion.
example_zh: 作出结论前不要只是粗略浏览证据。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 非正式用语，表示工作或学习没有以前认真。
example_en: The team cannot slack off before the final stage.
example_zh: 团队在最后阶段前不能松懈。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 the brakes 连用，表示突然用力制动；也可指迅速加上限制。
example_en: The driver had to slam on the brakes to avoid the animal.
example_zh: 驾驶员不得不猛踩刹车以避开那只动物。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示因烦躁而突然对某人说重话，也可指动物快速咬去。
example_en: People under pressure sometimes snap at those closest to them.
example_zh: 承受压力的人有时会厉声对待身边最亲近的人。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示恢复原状或状态，也可指立刻以尖锐语气回答。
example_en: The flexible material should snap back into shape.
example_zh: 这种柔性材料应该会迅速恢复原形。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示某物因快速用力而断开，也可表示突然关闭开关。
example_en: A strong wind could snap off the weaker branches.
example_zh: 强风可能会折断较脆弱的树枝。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示突然拿起某物，也可指很快买走或接受机会。
example_en: She had to snatch up the papers before the wind scattered them.
example_zh: 她不得不迅速抓起文件，以免被风吹散。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示为了不被注意而秘密离开某地或人群。
example_en: The child tried to sneak away while everyone was distracted.
example_zh: 大家分心时，那个孩子试图悄悄离开。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示不被发现地进入，也可指某事物逐渐而不明显地出现。
example_en: Someone managed to sneak in through an unlocked side door.
example_zh: 有人设法从未上锁的侧门偷偷进入。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指从橄榄果实提取的植物油，常用于烹饪和调味。
example_en: The recipe uses olive oil instead of butter.
example_zh: 这份食谱用橄榄油代替黄油。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可不接宾语表示悄悄离开，也可接宾语表示暗中把某物带出。
example_en: The guests tried to sneak out before the long speech began.
example_zh: 客人们试图在长篇讲话开始前悄悄离开。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 on 连用，表示不被察觉地接近；也可指时间或情况悄然到来。
example_en: Do not sneak up on an animal that may be frightened.
example_zh: 不要悄悄靠近可能受惊的动物。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示给食物加香料，也可比喻让内容或活动更生动。
example_en: A short demonstration could spice up the lecture.
example_zh: 一个简短演示可以让讲座更生动。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接名词或动名词，表示做出低于自身道德标准的行为。
example_en: A fair opponent would never stoop to spreading false rumors.
example_zh: 公平的对手绝不会卑劣到散布虚假谣言。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 with 连用，表示话语、故事或经历触动他人的情感或记忆。
example_en: The speaker's honest account seemed to strike a chord with the audience.
example_zh: 演讲者坦诚的讲述似乎引起了观众的共鸣。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示在已有事物末尾或之外增加费用、条件或内容，常含额外之意。
example_en: The airline may tack on an extra charge for large bags.
example_zh: 航空公司可能会对大件行李追加费用。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 与某人争斗；处理棘手问题
usage_note_zh: 表示卷入冲突，或试图应对强大对手和复杂问题。
example_en: Small firms may hesitate to tangle with a powerful competitor.
example_zh: 小企业可能不愿与强大的竞争对手较量。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示小心地区分紧密相连的因素、观点或物体。
example_en: Researchers must tease apart the effects of age and environment.
example_zh: 研究人员必须梳理清楚年龄和环境各自的影响。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示剪去植物过长部分，也可比喻适度减少计划或开支。
example_en: Gardeners trim back the bushes before new growth begins.
example_zh: 园丁在新枝生长前修剪灌木。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示减少规模、数量或不必要的部分，使事物更简洁。
example_en: The editor helped trim down the report to twenty pages.
example_zh: 编辑帮助把报告精简到二十页。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示把物品放在安全隐蔽处，也可非正式地表示吃下大量食物。
example_en: Tuck away the original document in a secure drawer.
example_zh: 把原始文件妥善藏在一个安全的抽屉里。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示把衣物边缘塞进去、把人盖好，或非正式地表示开始大吃。
example_en: Please tuck in the loose edge of the blanket.
example_zh: 请把毯子松开的边缘塞好。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 on 连用，表示相机或界面放大某一区域以查看细节。
example_en: Zoom in on the upper corner to examine the tiny mark.
example_zh: 放大上方角落，检查那个细小标记。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 of 连用，表示在承诺参与后改变主意并退出。
example_en: One investor threatened to back out of the agreement.
example_zh: 一名投资者威胁要退出协议。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示突出特点、推出产品，也可指出版书籍。
example_en: Good lighting can bring out the detail in the painting.
example_zh: 良好的照明能够突出画作中的细节。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示数量、力量或压力经过一段时间逐步增加。
example_en: Regular training will build up strength and endurance.
example_zh: 经常训练会逐渐增强力量和耐力。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示接受某种观点或方案，也可指投资并获得部分所有权。
example_en: Employees are more likely to buy into a plan they helped design.
example_zh: 员工更可能接受自己参与设计的计划。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示请专家协助、要求归还物品，或打电话告知情况。
example_en: The hospital decided to call in an additional specialist.
example_zh: 医院决定请来一名额外的专家。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示把票券或投资换成现金，常与 on 连用表示利用机会获利。
example_en: Some companies tried to cash in on the sudden demand.
example_zh: 一些公司试图利用突然增长的需求获利。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示达到他人的位置或水平，也可与 with 连用表示了解近况。
example_en: Students can use the weekend to catch up on missed work.
example_zh: 学生可以利用周末补上落下的功课。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 非正式用语，表示临到行动时因为胆怯而放弃。
example_en: He did not want to chicken out after months of preparation.
example_zh: 准备了几个月后，他不想因为害怕而退出。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示把障碍、废物或用完的物品从某处移走。
example_en: Workers must clear away the fallen rocks before traffic can resume.
example_zh: 恢复交通前，工人必须清除落石。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示把场所内的物品全部移走，也可非正式地命令人离开。
example_en: We need to clear out the storage room before repairs begin.
example_zh: 维修开始前，我们需要清空储藏室。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示消除误会或问题，也可指天气变晴或疾病好转。
example_en: A written statement may clear up the confusion.
example_zh: 一份书面声明可能会澄清这场混乱。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可按字面表示向下攀爬，也可比喻放弃原先强硬立场。
example_en: The minister refused to climb down despite growing opposition.
example_zh: 尽管反对声日益增加，这位部长拒绝让步。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指位于脊柱内、连接脑与身体许多神经的中枢神经组织。
example_en: The spinal cord carries signals between the brain and much of the body.
example_zh: 脊髓在大脑与身体大部分区域之间传递信号。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 较书面地表示没有预料地遇到某人或发现某物。
example_en: Hikers may come upon an abandoned shelter near the top of the hill.
example_zh: 徒步者可能会在山顶附近偶然发现一座废弃的避难所。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示把物品切成小块，也可非正式地表示使人难过或行为嬉闹。
example_en: Cut up the fruit and divide it among the children.
example_zh: 把水果切开，分给孩子们。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 非正式用语可表示开始用餐，也可指建立防御或把某物埋入。
example_en: The food is ready, so everyone can dig in.
example_zh: 饭菜准备好了，大家可以开吃了。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示彻底取消制度、规则或不再使用某物。
example_en: The reform aims to do away with unnecessary paperwork.
example_zh: 这项改革旨在取消不必要的文书工作。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 贯彻到底；完成后续行动
usage_note_zh: 表示把已经开始或承诺的事情继续完成，常与 on 或 with 连用。
example_en: A good plan fails unless people follow through on their promises.
example_zh: 如果人们不履行承诺，再好的计划也会失败。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示触及某物、间接表达意思，或努力发现事实。
example_en: The review tries to get at the underlying cause of the problem.
example_zh: 这项审查试图查明问题的根本原因。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接气味、热量、光或气体等从某物散发出的事物。
example_en: Some plants give off a strong scent at night.
example_zh: 有些植物在夜间会散发浓烈香气。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示向前进行、陪同，也常与 with 连用表示接受建议或决定。
example_en: I am willing to go along with the proposal if costs remain limited.
example_zh: 如果成本保持在有限范围内，我愿意同意这项提议。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 四处走动；传播；足够分配
usage_note_zh: 可表示移动、消息或疾病传播，也可指数量足够所有人使用。
example_en: There may not be enough food to go around.
example_zh: 食物可能不够所有人分。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示进入水下，也常比喻企业因财务困难而倒闭。
example_en: Without emergency support, several local firms could go under.
example_zh: 如果没有紧急支持，几家当地企业可能会倒闭。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 非正式表达，常用于鼓励处于困难中的人继续努力。
example_en: Hang in; the most difficult part is nearly over.
example_zh: 坚持住，最困难的部分快要过去了。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示限制价格或噪声，也可指勉强不把食物吐出来。
example_en: Better insulation helps keep down heating costs.
example_zh: 更好的保温措施有助于降低供暖费用。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可接宾语表示阻挡，也可用作警告标语要求不要进入。
example_en: These thick curtains help keep out the afternoon heat.
example_zh: 这些厚窗帘有助于阻挡午后的热气。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示不处罚某人、让人下车，或使烟花等爆响。
example_en: The judge refused to let off the company with only a warning.
example_zh: 法官拒绝只给这家公司警告而免除处罚。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示产生光、点燃烟火，也可形容人的表情突然明亮起来。
example_en: Thousands of lamps will light up the riverfront tonight.
example_zh: 今晚数千盏灯将照亮河畔。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 把某人锁在外面；阻止登录
usage_note_zh: 表示因门锁或系统权限使人无法进入，也可指雇主禁止员工工作。
example_en: Too many failed attempts may lock out a user temporarily.
example_zh: 失败尝试次数过多可能会暂时阻止用户登录。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示错误地把人或事物当成另一个，也可指把材料混合。
example_en: Similar labels can cause staff to mix up the two samples.
example_zh: 相似的标签可能导致员工混淆两份样本。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示从某人或某地旁边经过，也可指机会或时间过去。
example_en: Do not let this rare opportunity pass by unnoticed.
example_zh: 不要让这个难得的机会在不知不觉中溜走。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示事件发展到结局、资源用尽，或场景被完整表演。
example_en: We must wait and see how the negotiations play out.
example_zh: 我们必须等待，看看谈判最终如何发展。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示从重病或危机中幸存，也可接宾语表示帮助某人渡过。
example_en: With prompt treatment, most patients pull through.
example_zh: 得到及时治疗后，大多数患者能够康复。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示克服阻力使提案获批，也可指坚持完成困难任务。
example_en: The committee hopes to push through the reform before summer.
example_zh: 委员会希望在夏季前推动改革通过。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接建议、观点或人选，表示正式交由他人考虑。
example_en: Researchers put forward a new explanation for the pattern.
example_zh: 研究人员为这一规律提出了新的解释。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 接通电话；使经历；完成手续
usage_note_zh: 可表示连接来电、使人经历困难过程，或正式处理申请。
example_en: Could you put through my call to the finance department?
example_zh: 你能把我的电话接到财务部门吗？

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示车辆撞过某物、活动超过预定时间，或简要检查内容。
example_en: Let us run over the main points once more before the interview.
example_zh: 面试前我们再快速过一遍要点。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接名词或动名词，表示有计划地开始一项任务。
example_en: The team set about designing a safer replacement.
example_zh: 团队着手设计一种更安全的替代品。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可不接宾语表示启程，也可接警报、反应或爆炸装置。
example_en: A minor electrical fault could set off the alarm.
example_zh: 一个小电气故障就可能触发警报。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示除去疾病、情绪或追踪者，也可按字面把某物抖落。
example_en: It took the industry years to shake off the effects of the crisis.
example_zh: 这个行业花了多年才摆脱危机的影响。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示大幅改变组织或制度，也可指使人情绪受到强烈冲击。
example_en: The new director promised to shake up the outdated system.
example_zh: 新任负责人承诺彻底改革陈旧的制度。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可不接宾语表示卖弄，也可接物品或能力表示刻意展示。
example_en: The exhibition allows young engineers to show off their inventions.
example_zh: 这场展览让年轻工程师有机会展示自己的发明。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 签约受雇；加入；开始使用服务
usage_note_zh: 可表示签署工作合同、参加组织，或登录系统和登记服务。
example_en: Several experienced nurses agreed to sign on for the new program.
example_zh: 几名经验丰富的护士同意加入新项目。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示代表某人表达意见，也可说明事实本身具有证明力。
example_en: The survey cannot speak for every member of the community.
example_zh: 这项调查无法代表社区中的每一个人。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 against 连用，表示公开反对不公或危险做法。
example_en: Employees should feel safe to speak out about serious misconduct.
example_zh: 员工应该能够安全地公开举报严重不当行为。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示离开重要职位或权力位置，通常是主动或在压力下发生。
example_en: The chairperson announced that she would step down in June.
example_zh: 主席宣布她将在六月辞职。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示人在空间上不分开，也可比喻困难中相互支持。
example_en: The group agreed to stick together until help arrived.
example_zh: 这群人同意待在一起，直到救援到来。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示撤回言论、把商品退回，也可指唤起过去的记忆。
example_en: The newspaper had to take back its unsupported accusation.
example_zh: 这家报纸不得不撤回没有证据支持的指控。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 含义随宾语变化，也可表示购买保险或贷款等正式安排。
example_en: The surgeon will take out the damaged tissue carefully.
example_zh: 外科医生会小心取出受损组织。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示丢弃物品、命令某人离开，或拒绝接受提议和案件。
example_en: The court may throw out evidence obtained illegally.
example_zh: 法院可能会排除非法取得的证据。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示一个事件引发强烈反应、争论、冲突或爆炸。
example_en: The sudden announcement could touch off a wave of protests.
example_zh: 这项突然发布的公告可能会引发一波抗议。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示上交作业或证据、把嫌疑人交给警方，也可非正式地表示睡觉。
example_en: Witnesses were asked to turn in any relevant photographs.
example_zh: 目击者被要求提交所有相关照片。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示意外到场、提高音量或温度，也可指丢失物品重新被发现。
example_en: New evidence may turn up during a wider search.
example_zh: 扩大搜索范围后可能会发现新证据。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 逐渐磨损；使疲惫或屈服
usage_note_zh: 可表示摩擦使物品变薄，也可比喻长期压力削弱人的抵抗。
example_en: Repeated delays can wear down even the most patient travelers.
example_zh: 反复延误会让最有耐心的旅客也感到疲惫。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 写信提出；投票填写非候选人姓名
usage_note_zh: 可表示向机构写信，也可指在选票上写入未列名候选人的姓名。
example_en: Residents can write in to request a copy of the report.
example_zh: 居民可以写信索取这份报告的副本。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 根据某事采取行动；作用于
usage_note_zh: 与 act on 含义相近，后接信息、建议或受到作用的对象。
example_en: Authorities must act upon credible reports of danger.
example_zh: 有关部门必须根据可信的危险报告采取行动。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示在计划或计算中把某种情况纳入考虑。
example_en: The schedule should allow for unexpected travel delays.
example_zh: 日程安排应该考虑到意外的路途延误。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示身体向后移动，也可指不再威胁、批评或干涉。
example_en: Both sides need to back off before the dispute becomes violent.
example_zh: 双方都需要停止施压，以免争端演变为暴力冲突。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示个人或团体为了共同目标而组成联盟、共同采取行动。
example_en: Several villages chose to band together to protect the forest.
example_zh: 几个村庄选择联合起来保护森林。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示通过努力迫使攻击者后退，也可比喻控制威胁或问题。
example_en: Firefighters worked all night to beat back the flames.
example_zh: 消防员彻夜工作以遏制火势。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示谈判或关系突然停止，也可指一部分从整体断开。
example_en: The two countries threatened to break off negotiations.
example_zh: 两国威胁要中断谈判。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接已有的思想、成果或优势，表示以其为基础进一步发展。
example_en: The new study will build upon findings from earlier research.
example_zh: 这项新研究将以早期研究成果为基础继续推进。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示利用趋势、事件或他人的处境获取金钱或其他利益，常含批评意味。
example_en: Some sellers tried to cash in on the temporary shortage.
example_zh: 一些卖家试图利用暂时的短缺获利。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常与 at 连用，表示通过持续小动作慢慢减少或破坏某物。
example_en: Rising costs continue to chip away at household savings.
example_zh: 不断上涨的成本持续侵蚀家庭储蓄。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 打卡上班；记录速度或时间
usage_note_zh: 可表示记录到岗时间，也可说明完成活动所用的时间或速度。
example_en: Staff must clock in before entering the production area.
example_zh: 员工进入生产区前必须打卡上班。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示某个想法、名字或形象自然出现在意识中。
example_en: Several possible explanations come to mind immediately.
example_zh: 几个可能的解释立刻浮现在脑海中。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示接近某人，也可说明表现达到要求或数量达到某个水平。
example_en: The final product must come up to international safety standards.
example_zh: 最终产品必须达到国际安全标准。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示温度下降，也可指愤怒或热情逐渐减弱。
example_en: Take a short walk and cool off before continuing the discussion.
example_zh: 继续讨论前先散一会儿步，让自己冷静下来。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示用刀、剪刀或工具移除不需要或受损的部分。
example_en: The doctor had to cut away the infected tissue.
example_zh: 医生不得不切除受感染的组织。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接事物开始存在的年代或时期，通常用一般现在时。
example_en: The oldest sections of the wall date from the twelfth century.
example_zh: 城墙最古老的部分始建于十二世纪。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示把纸牌、任务、奖励或惩罚分给多人。
example_en: The dealer began to deal out five cards to each player.
example_zh: 发牌者开始给每名玩家发五张牌。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示一个群体中的成员陆续死亡，直到数量大幅减少或完全消失。
example_en: Native plants may die off if the drought continues.
example_zh: 如果干旱持续，本地植物可能会相继枯死。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 通常因疼痛或大笑而身体猛然向前弯曲，也可接宾语表示使其弯腰。
example_en: The sudden pain made him double over.
example_zh: 突如其来的疼痛使他弯下身子。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示迫使人或动物离开，也可比喻某种因素把企业或做法排挤出去。
example_en: Rising rents may drive out long-established local shops.
example_zh: 不断上涨的租金可能会迫使经营多年的本地商店离开。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 归入；受到某事物管辖或影响
usage_note_zh: 后接类别、法律、权力或怀疑，表示被包括或控制。
example_en: These activities fall under the authority of a different agency.
example_zh: 这些活动归另一个机构管辖。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示人或物从一点向不同方向分散，常用于搜索行动。
example_en: The rescue teams will fan out across the valley at sunrise.
example_zh: 救援队将在日出时分散到山谷各处。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 非正式用语，表示谨慎询问以了解某人的意见或反应。
example_en: The negotiator tried to feel out both sides before making a proposal.
example_zh: 谈判人员在提出建议前试图摸清双方态度。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示抵御攻击者，也可指身体抵抗感染或困倦等影响。
example_en: The immune system works to fight off harmful organisms.
example_zh: 免疫系统会抵抗有害生物。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示发动机器、点火，也可使人变得兴奋或积极。
example_en: The coach's speech helped fire up the team before the final.
example_zh: 教练的讲话在决赛前激发了全队的斗志。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接需要找到的人、物或信息，含义随语境变化。
example_en: We need to get hold of the original contract before the meeting.
example_zh: 会议前我们需要找到合同原件。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 通常与 with 连用，表示开始或恢复与某人联系。
example_en: Please get in touch with the support team if the error continues.
example_zh: 如果错误持续出现，请联系支持团队。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 开始生效；踢坏进入；出钱
usage_note_zh: 非正式用语，可表示药物或规则开始起作用，也可指共同出资。
example_en: The new restrictions will kick in at the beginning of next month.
example_zh: 新限制措施将在下月初开始生效。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 非正式用语，表示迫使某人离开场所、学校或组织。
example_en: The club may kick out members who repeatedly break its rules.
example_zh: 俱乐部可能会开除屡次违反规定的成员。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示碰撞使人或物失去平衡而倒下。
example_en: A passing cart could knock over the display.
example_zh: 经过的手推车可能会撞倒展品。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 与某人同住；接受并忍受
usage_note_zh: 可按字面表示共同居住，也可表示接受无法改变的不理想情况。
example_en: Residents should not have to live with unsafe drinking water.
example_zh: 居民不应该被迫忍受不安全的饮用水。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示不再看某人或某事，有时暗示不愿面对问题。
example_en: It was difficult to look away from the dramatic rescue footage.
example_zh: 很难把目光从那段紧张的救援画面上移开。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 强调；特意做某事；得一分
usage_note_zh: 常与 of 连用，表示有意识地确保某事发生，也可表示明确提出观点。
example_en: The report should make a point of separating fact from opinion.
example_zh: 这份报告应该特别注意区分事实与观点。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指岩浆、火山灰和气体从火山释放出来的地质事件。
example_en: A major volcanic eruption can disrupt air travel across a wide region.
example_zh: 大规模火山喷发会扰乱广大地区的航空旅行。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示移动以腾出空间，也可比喻让别人接替位置。
example_en: Could you move over so that another passenger can sit down?
example_zh: 你能挪一下，让另一名乘客坐下吗？

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 非正式用语，常与 to 连用，表示承认自己做了错事或隐瞒了事实。
example_en: Those responsible should own up to their mistakes.
example_zh: 负有责任的人应该承认自己的错误。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示把自己重视或不愿失去的物品、金钱或权利交出去。
example_en: The museum was unwilling to part with the rare manuscript.
example_zh: 博物馆不愿割舍这份珍贵手稿。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示把信息或物品给别人，也可非正式地表示拒绝机会。
example_en: Please pass on the safety instructions to new volunteers.
example_zh: 请把安全说明转达给新志愿者。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示尽管疲劳、困难或反对仍继续行动。
example_en: The expedition decided to press on despite the worsening weather.
example_zh: 尽管天气恶化，探险队仍决定继续前进。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可表示延后安排，也可指反对某项要求或影响。
example_en: Local groups began to push back against the proposed cuts.
example_zh: 当地团体开始抵制拟议中的削减措施。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 依靠；取决于；放在某物上
usage_note_zh: 可说明结论以证据为基础，也可表示责任或目光落在某人身上。
example_en: The final decision will rest on the strength of the evidence.
example_zh: 最终决定将取决于证据的说服力。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示通过证据或决定排除某个原因、选择或可能性。
example_en: The test cannot completely rule out a hidden fault.
example_zh: 这项测试无法完全排除隐藏故障。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指某人滥用受托责任或破坏他人给予的信任，具体法律含义依语境而定。
example_en: Sharing confidential records would be a serious breach of trust.
example_zh: 分享保密记录将是严重的背信行为。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常用于 broad-spectrum 作定语，表示能够作用于多种对象或覆盖广泛范围。
example_en: The laboratory uses a broad spectrum of methods to identify unknown materials.
example_zh: 实验室使用范围广泛的方法来鉴定未知材料。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可指物体沿会发生碰撞的路线移动，也可比喻双方走向严重冲突。
example_en: The two agencies appear to be on a collision course over funding.
example_zh: 两个机构似乎因资金问题正走向冲突。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指通过公开购买昂贵商品或服务来展示财富和社会地位的消费行为。
example_en: The article links conspicuous consumption to social pressure.
example_zh: 这篇文章把炫耀性消费与社会压力联系起来。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指未经许可实施受版权专有权控制的行为，具体认定取决于适用法律。
example_en: The publisher removed the image after receiving a copyright infringement notice.
example_zh: 出版社收到侵犯版权通知后删除了这张图片。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 泛指由选举人组成并负责选出特定职位的机构；美国正式名称通常写作 the Electoral College。
example_en: The electoral college system is a central topic in the course.
example_zh: 选举团制度是这门课程的核心主题。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指不遵循固定格律、韵脚或诗行长度模式的诗歌形式。
example_en: The poet uses free verse to create a conversational rhythm.
example_zh: 这位诗人用自由诗营造对话般的节奏。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指视觉系统对图形、颜色、运动或空间关系产生与物理现实不同的感知。
example_en: The pattern creates an optical illusion of movement.
example_zh: 这个图案产生了一种运动的视错觉。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指以违法方式故意逃避应缴税款，与合法税务筹划不同。
example_en: The investigation uncovered a complex tax evasion scheme.
example_zh: 调查发现了一项复杂的逃税计划。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指低密度城市建设向外围大面积扩展，常带来交通和土地利用问题。
example_en: Urban sprawl can increase dependence on private cars.
example_zh: 城市蔓延会增加对私家车的依赖。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指符合条件的选民中实际参加投票的比例或人数。
example_en: Voter turnout was highest among people over sixty.
example_zh: 六十岁以上人群的投票率最高。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 另一个自我；亲密代言人
usage_note_zh: 可指人格的另一面、虚构身份，也可表示与某人关系密切并代表其行事的人。
example_en: The fictional detective became the writer's alter ego.
example_zh: 这个虚构侦探成了作家的另一个自我。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指有固定格律但不押韵的诗体，英语文学中常见无韵抑扬五步格。
example_en: The play contains long passages written in blank verse.
example_zh: 这部戏剧包含许多用无韵诗写成的长段落。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指通常由少数演奏者在较小空间演奏、每个声部常由一人承担的音乐。
example_en: The festival includes an evening of chamber music.
example_zh: 艺术节包括一场室内乐之夜。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指十进制数中分隔整数部分与小数部分的符号。
example_en: Moving the decimal point one place changed the result tenfold.
example_zh: 把小数点移动一位使结果变化了十倍。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可按字面指产生回声的空间，也比喻只接触强化既有观点的信息环境。
example_en: The discussion group became an echo chamber with little room for disagreement.
example_zh: 这个讨论组变成了几乎容不下异议的信息茧房。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 非正式表达，指完成费力任务所需的实际劳动和力气。
example_en: The old table needs soap, water, and plenty of elbow grease.
example_zh: 这张旧桌子需要用肥皂、水和大量力气来清理。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 常用于 the flip side，表示某种情况不太明显或相反的一面。
example_en: The flip side of flexibility is a lack of long-term certainty.
example_zh: 灵活性的另一面是缺乏长期确定性。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可指一次赢得某项目全部主要赛事，也特指棒球中的满垒全垒打。
example_en: Winning all four major titles would complete a grand slam.
example_zh: 赢得全部四项主要冠军将成就大满贯。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指汽车前排仪表板内用于放置小物品的储物空间。
example_en: The vehicle manual is kept in the glove compartment.
example_zh: 车辆说明书放在仪表板储物箱里。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指保护设备或航天器免受高温和热流损害的材料或结构。
example_en: The spacecraft relies on a heat shield during reentry.
example_zh: 航天器在再入大气层时依靠防热盾保护。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 英语中通常指 a 和 an，用于表示非特指的可数名词单数。
example_en: Use the indefinite article an before a spoken vowel sound.
example_zh: 在发音以元音音素开头的词前使用不定冠词 an。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指较轻原子核结合成较重原子核并释放能量的核反应过程。
example_en: Nuclear fusion powers the Sun and other stars.
example_zh: 核聚变为太阳和其他恒星提供能量。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指把被拘禁者与其他人隔离关押的监禁方式。
example_en: The report examines the psychological effects of prolonged solitary confinement.
example_zh: 这份报告研究长期单独监禁的心理影响。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可指拔河比赛，也可比喻双方围绕权力、资源或控制权进行拉锯。
example_en: Budget talks became a tug of war between the two departments.
example_zh: 预算谈判成了两个部门之间的拉锯战。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 政治迫害；无根据的搜捕
usage_note_zh: 指在证据不足时大规模寻找并惩罚被视为异己或有罪的人。
example_en: Critics warned that the inquiry must not become a witch hunt.
example_zh: 批评者警告，这项调查不能演变成政治迫害。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 市民自豪感；城市荣誉感
usage_note_zh: 指居民因所属城市、社区及其成就而产生的自豪和责任感。
example_en: Restoring the historic theater strengthened local civic pride.
example_zh: 修复这座历史悠久的剧院增强了当地市民的自豪感。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指为休闲旅行设计、提供住宿和娱乐设施的大型客船。
example_en: The cruise liner remained outside the port during the storm.
example_zh: 暴风雨期间，这艘大型邮轮停留在港口外。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指供柴油发动机使用、通常由石油炼制而成的液体燃料。
example_en: The company is testing an alternative to conventional diesel fuel.
example_zh: 这家公司正在测试传统柴油的替代品。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指建筑物中供电梯轿厢上下运行的垂直空间。
example_en: Smoke entered the upper floors through the elevator shaft.
example_zh: 烟雾通过电梯井进入了较高楼层。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 光纤的；光导纤维相关的
usage_note_zh: 作复合形容词时常写作 fiber-optic，美式拼写为 fiber，英式拼写为 fibre。
example_en: The hospital installed a fiber optic network for faster data transfer.
example_zh: 医院安装了光纤网络，以提高数据传输速度。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可指以植物为主要来源的药物，也可指使用草药的医疗传统；其安全性和效果因产品而异。
example_en: Patients should tell their doctors about any herbal medicine they use.
example_zh: 患者应该把自己使用的任何草药告知医生。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 婴儿死亡率；婴儿死亡现象
usage_note_zh: 在人口统计中通常指未满一岁的婴儿死亡情况，常与 rate 连用。
example_en: Clean water and basic health services can reduce infant mortality.
example_zh: 清洁用水和基本医疗服务能够降低婴儿死亡率。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指没有经过有意识的逐步推理而产生的感觉或判断。
example_en: An intuitive feeling may guide inquiry, but it cannot replace evidence.
example_zh: 直觉感受可以引导研究，但不能取代证据。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指法院、法官及处理法律争议和审判案件的制度整体。
example_en: An independent judicial system is essential to fair trials.
example_zh: 独立的司法体系对公平审判至关重要。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 土地保有制度；土地权属
usage_note_zh: 指个人或群体依法拥有、占有或使用土地的规则和安排。
example_en: Secure land tenure can encourage farmers to invest in long-term improvements.
example_zh: 稳定的土地权属能够鼓励农民进行长期改良投资。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指规范航运、海上贸易、船舶和相关海事活动的法律领域。
example_en: The dispute will be settled according to international maritime law.
example_zh: 这场争议将依据国际海事法解决。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 群体性恐慌；集体歇斯底里
usage_note_zh: 指恐惧、错误信念或强烈反应在群体中迅速传播的现象。
example_en: False reports can trigger mass hysteria during an emergency.
example_zh: 虚假报道可能在紧急情况下引发群体性恐慌。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指特定人群在一定时期内死亡人数所占的比例。
example_en: The study compares the mortality rate across different age groups.
example_zh: 这项研究比较不同年龄组的死亡率。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指依据风格、形式、传统或文化背景划分的音乐类别。
example_en: The platform allows listeners to search by music genre.
example_zh: 这个平台允许听众按音乐类型搜索。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指利用透镜、反射镜或其他光学元件观察、测量或成像的设备。
example_en: The telescope is an optical instrument designed to collect faint light.
example_zh: 望远镜是一种用于收集微弱光线的光学仪器。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指从某处能够看到的广阔、连续景色。
example_en: The hilltop offers a panoramic view of the entire valley.
example_zh: 山顶可以俯瞰整个山谷的全景。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指发电设施、输电线路和配电系统相互连接形成的网络。
example_en: Extreme heat placed heavy demand on the regional power grid.
example_zh: 极端高温给区域电网带来巨大需求压力。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指含有放射性物质、需要专门管理和处置的废弃材料。
example_en: Radioactive waste must be stored under carefully controlled conditions.
example_zh: 放射性废物必须在严格控制的条件下储存。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指土壤表层被水、风或人类活动带走和破坏的过程。
example_en: Planting trees can reduce soil erosion on steep slopes.
example_zh: 植树能够减少陡坡上的土壤侵蚀。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 现代英语中作形容词通常写作 tax-deductible，指费用可按适用税法从应税所得等项目中扣除。
example_en: Some business expenses may be tax deductible under local rules.
example_zh: 根据当地规定，一些经营费用可能可以抵税。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指按照适用税法从应税收入或税额中扣除的金额或项目。
example_en: The guide explains how to claim a tax deduction for approved donations.
example_zh: 这份指南说明如何为符合条件的捐赠申请税收扣除。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 通常写作 the Western Hemisphere，指本初子午线以西、180 度经线以东的半个地球。
example_en: The storm became one of the strongest recorded in the western hemisphere.
example_zh: 这场风暴成为西半球有记录以来最强的风暴之一。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指从地下开采、尚未经过炼制的液态石油。
example_en: The refinery converts crude oil into fuels and other products.
example_zh: 炼油厂把原油转化为燃料和其他产品。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指投保人为获得保险保障而定期或一次性支付给保险人的费用。
example_en: The annual insurance premium depends on the level of coverage.
example_zh: 年度保险费取决于保障范围。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 现代英语中通常写作 self-indulgent，表示过分满足自己的欲望或享受。
example_en: The memoir is honest without becoming self indulgent.
example_zh: 这本回忆录很坦诚，却没有变得自我放纵。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指与主要动词共同构成时态、语态、疑问或情态意义的动词。
example_en: In the question, do functions as an auxiliary verb.
example_zh: 在这个问句中，do 用作助动词。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指随时态、语气或主语变化，并能充当从句谓语核心的动词形式。
example_en: Every complete English clause normally contains a finite verb.
example_zh: 每个完整的英语分句通常都包含一个限定动词。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指为了增强表达、说服力或艺术效果而采用的语言技巧。
example_en: Repetition is a rhetorical device that can emphasize a central idea.
example_zh: 重复是一种能够强调核心观点的修辞手法。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指经济活动在一段时期内广泛下降，常伴随产出、投资或就业减少。
example_en: The economic recession caused unemployment to rise sharply.
example_zh: 经济衰退导致失业率大幅上升。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指个人或群体之间相互沟通、影响和回应的过程。
example_en: Remote work can reduce informal social interaction among colleagues.
example_zh: 远程工作可能减少同事之间的非正式社交互动。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指个人、群体或地区在收入、财富和经济机会方面存在差距。
example_en: The report examines the link between education and economic inequality.
example_zh: 这份报告研究教育与经济不平等之间的联系。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指通过可检验的观察、测量或实验获得并按科学方法评价的证据。
example_en: Public health advice should be based on the best available scientific evidence.
example_zh: 公共卫生建议应该以现有最佳科学证据为基础。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指一个社会的法律、法律机构以及制定、解释和执行法律的整体制度。
example_en: The legal system provides procedures for resolving disputes.
example_zh: 法律体系为解决争议提供程序。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指政府或公共机构为处理社会问题和实现公共目标制定的原则与行动。
example_en: Reliable data can improve the design of public policy.
example_zh: 可靠数据能够改善公共政策的设计。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指经济活动在衰退或危机后重新增长和改善的过程。
example_en: Consumer confidence may influence the speed of economic recovery.
example_zh: 消费者信心可能影响经济复苏的速度。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 指主动分析信息、检验证据和推理，并作出有根据判断的能力。
example_en: Critical thinking helps students distinguish evidence from assertion.
example_zh: 批判性思维帮助学生区分证据与断言。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接新的事实、证据或情况，表示据此重新考虑或采取行动。
example_en: The policy was revised in light of recent research.
example_zh: 鉴于近期研究，这项政策得到了修订。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
meaning_zh: 在某事之后；作为某事的结果
usage_note_zh: 后接通常具有重大影响的事件，表示随后发生或受其影响。
example_en: New safety rules were introduced in the wake of the accident.
example_zh: 事故发生后出台了新的安全规定。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接困难、危险或反对，强调仍然坚持或采取行动。
example_en: The community remained united in the face of severe pressure.
example_zh: 面对巨大压力，社区仍然保持团结。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接规则、原则、趋势或预期，表示相互协调或相符。
example_en: The revised plan is in line with current safety standards.
example_zh: 修订后的计划符合现行安全标准。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: to 是介词，后接名词或动名词，表示行动的目的。
example_en: The city redesigned the crossing with a view to improving pedestrian safety.
example_zh: 这座城市重新设计了路口，旨在提高行人安全。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 表示经过一段心理过程后接受困难、损失或无法改变的现实。
example_en: The town must come to terms with the decline of its old industry.
example_zh: 这座城镇必须接受并适应传统产业的衰落。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 可用于 take something for granted，表示未经思考就假定为真或忽视其价值。
example_en: We should not take for granted the availability of clean water.
example_zh: 我们不应把清洁用水的供应视为理所当然。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接规则、条件、变化或不利影响，具体含义随语境变化。
example_en: The schedule may be subject to change without notice.
example_zh: 日程可能会在不另行通知的情况下变更。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接需要处理的困难、选择或事实，常用于被动结构。
example_en: New managers may be confronted with decisions that have no easy answer.
example_zh: 新任管理者可能会面对没有简单答案的决定。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接环境、物质、风险或思想，可表示有意接触或受到不利影响。
example_en: Workers should not be exposed to harmful dust without protection.
example_zh: 没有防护时，工人不应暴露在有害粉尘中。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接法律、规则、要求或正式请求，语气较正式。
example_en: Manufacturers must comply with updated safety regulations.
example_zh: 制造商必须遵守更新后的安全规定。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接名词或动名词，较正式地要求或说明不做某事。
example_en: Visitors must refrain from touching the fragile objects.
example_zh: 访客不得触摸易损物品。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接根本原因、来源或起点，主语通常是结果。
example_en: Many of the delays stem from a shortage of trained staff.
example_zh: 许多延误源于受过培训的员工短缺。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接服务、出版物、观点或组织，具体含义由语境决定。
example_en: Not every scientist will subscribe to the same interpretation.
example_zh: 并非每位科学家都会赞同同一种解释。

selection_reason: independently selected for learning value and first-introduction level
usage_note_zh: 后接受到不利影响的活动、设备或过程。
example_en: Bright street lighting can interfere with astronomical observations.
example_zh: 明亮的街道照明会干扰天文观测。
